title: Five minutes, 28 covers, 300 tyres: How Galle's 130-member groundstaff beat the rain
content: The rain may have tested Galle, but its groundstaff never blinked. Meet the 130-member groundstaff, who raced against the weather, mastered the art of covering the ground and ensured precious playing time was not lost during the first Test between India vs Sri Test played at the Galle International Cricket Stadium.

title: Meet 10-yr-old Hsu Ting-wei, winner of Silicon Valley invention award
content: In a remarkable showcase of talent, Taiwanese inventors made waves at the Silicon Valley International Festival. Among them, a ten-year-old prodigy captured prestigious awards with his innovative AI-powered electronic nose, designed to identify airborne chemical threats and health risks. The event highlighted the impressive achievement of Taiwanese participants, who collectively earned twenty-four gold medals, demonstrating the practical benefits of emerging technologies in daily life.

title: ‘Cannot afford any mistake’: Harmanpreet rues India’s lapses despite Pakistan win
content: In a nail-biting showdown at the Hockey World Cup, India triumphed over Pakistan, much to the delight of fans. Captain Harmanpreet Singh highlighted essential defensive weaknesses that need addressing for the challenges ahead. With praises from the coach regarding the team's attacking strategy and chances created, India now look forward to battle in the next round, where the competition will only intensify.

title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18
content: Beginning September 18, 2026, new rules from the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services will reshape the Green Card application landscape. Applicants will undergo a more rigorous public charge evaluation that now includes a broader range of public benefits. Additionally, previous cash assistance and long-term institutional stays will factor into decisions, significantly affecting family and employment-based immigration cases.

title: 746lb bluefin tuna caught off Yorkshire as species returns to UK waters
content: A giant 746lb (338kg) Atlantic bluefin tuna has been caught off the Yorkshire coast, around 10 miles from Whitby, after nearly 90 years. Scientists say warming seas, recovering fish stocks and tighter fishing controls may be behind the species’ return. The catch comes near Whitby, where an 851lb British record was set in 1933.

title: 1963 rotating house by California builder hits market for first time
content: A remarkable rotating house, built in 1963 by the imaginative Sam Harkleroad, is now available for sale, showcasing a one-of-a-kind design. Overlooking busy Highway 101, this property comprises seven homes, all presently leased, with a total price tag of $3.3 million. Harkleroad's distinctive architectural legacy thrives across Marin County, but his grandson has chosen to list the asset, citing the complexities of maintenance as a challenge.

title: US tech firm asks court to block CEO who fired 900 in 79-second call
content: Better Home & Finance is suing former CEO Vishal Garg in a US court. The company seeks to block Garg from gathering shareholder support for his return. Garg allegedly violated securities laws by making misleading statements to regain his position. The board unanimously removed Garg after significant company losses and stock decline. Garg seeks reinstatement, offering to work for one dollar annually.

title: NCERT recasts political science textbook panel; 4 with RSS links among 20 members
content: NCERT has recast the team for preparing political science textbooks for Classes XI and XII, with one of the two books slated to be ready by Nov. The 20-member panel includes faculty from JNU, DU, IGNOU and NLU Delhi, among others. At least four members have links, past or present, with organisations associated with RSS-BJP.

title: Saints rookie Brock Rechsteiner, Scott Steiner's son, suplexes teammate
content: Brock Rechsteiner, the Saints rookie and son of WWE Hall of Famer Scott Steiner, became part of a heated Saints-Cowboys practice fight after giving Jalen Thompson a German suplex. Rechsteiner is trying to earn an NFL roster spot after joining New Orleans as an undrafted receiver, while his six-game suspension will keep him out of the start of the regular season.

title: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 map changes: All new POIs explained
content: Fortnite's island undergoes a major overhaul for Chapter 7 Season 4 Override.  New gaming-themed points of interest will be introduced to the island.  Iconic locations like Sonic's Green Hill Zone are arriving with the update.  Several existing points of interest will be removed and replaced by new ones.  The map changes promise a visually distinct and gameplay-rich experience for players.

title: NHL rumors: Hughes may want shorter deal, Batherson eyes 8 years
content: Minnesota Wild and Ottawa Senators face important contract talks soon. Quinn Hughes seeks a shorter deal, while Drake Batherson wants a longer one. Hughes is entering his final contract year with the Wild. Batherson also enters his final season with the Senators. Both players' contract situations are nearing a September fifteenth deadline.

title: 'Legal cockroaches united': CJP hails planned protest for Bar chief's resignation
content: A protest is planned against the Bar Council of India chairman over a withdrawn directive.  The All India Young Advocates Association will demonstrate demanding his resignation.  This follows the chairman's apology to law students regarding the NALSAR University controversy.  The initial directive barred NALSAR graduating students from becoming advocates.  The controversy involved a campaign against the Chief Justice of India's convocation participation.

title: Former wrestler arrested in Delhi opium case; claims drug use in ‘akhadas’
content: In a dramatic turn of events, Delhi Police have arrested Amit Sheoran, a former national-level wrestler, after he spent three years on the run from charges of opium smuggling. Sheoran's claims that fellow wrestlers resort to opium to enhance training efforts have stirred controversy. His identification as a key figure by another arrested supplier highlights the ongoing battle against organised crime in the region.

title: Hockey WC: India extend dominance over Pakistan with 5-3 thriller, seal next-round spot
content: In a thrilling Pool D showdown, India triumphed over Pakistan with a score of 5-3. With Harmanpreet Singh and Abhishek each netting two goals, India showcased their strength. Pakistan's Hannan Shahid and Sufyan Khan put up a valiant effort by scoring, yet India held their ground during the nail-biting final quarter, securing their advancement to the next stage of the World Cup.

title: 'Every Test match victory is special': KL Rahul after 165-run victory vs SL
content: KL Rahul said India’s 165-run win over Sri Lanka boosted confidence in handling spin-friendly conditions. He praised the team for executing its plans and credited thorough preparation for their success. Rahul also lauded Devdutt Padikkal’s maiden Test century, calling it a defining moment that helped set up the victory and hoping the young batter carries his confidence into future matches.

title: From Taco Tuesday to Fitting Friday: Trump puts Canada tariffs on ice for 72 hours
content: Canada avoided a significant tariff imposition after a last-minute reprieve. President Trump announced a three-day extension for trade negotiations with Canada. Substantial progress has been acknowledged, though significant work remains to finalize an agreement. The immediate dispute centers on Canadian trade practices and market access for American goods. Both nations aim to resolve these issues before the extended deadline expires.

title: 'Speechless' Garret Tan silences Lakshya Sen and Delhi crowd at BWF World C'ships
content: American teenager Garret Tan stunned Lakshya Sen, the 14th seed and the 2021 World Championships bronze medallist, in a thrilling three-set match at the Delhi World Championships. Overcoming crowd pressure, a head injury and Sen’s aggressive play, Tan triumphed 19-21, 21-19, 21-17, marking the biggest win of his career.

title: Khabib's 2018 warning to Gleison Tibau about Makhachev goes viral again

Makhachev then delivered a swift knockout, validating Nurmagomedov's early assessment.  He later became a dominant two-division UFC champion and record holder.  Nurmagomedov consistently supported Makhachev's remarkable championship journey.

title: Rhea Ripley vs Bianca Belair: 2026 net worth and earnings compared

title: "He was always there for me": Jayson Tatum's son, his source of strength

From Celtics celebrations to injury recovery, his father has climbed the league, and he’s been a source of joy, perspective and steadfast belief.

title: Govt planning to bring E10 back? Clamour grows after top bureaucrat's remark

title: NIA court issues non-bailable warrant against top LeT commander
content:
The NBW was issued last month against Mohammad Yaqoob, a designated terrorist of Pakistani origin.

JAMMU: A special NIA court in Jammu has issued a non-bailable warrant against a top commander of Pak-based LeT for his involvement in planning terror attacks on security forces and civilians in the Kashmir Valley. The NBW was issued last month against Mohammad Yaqoob, a designated terrorist of Pakistani origin, officials said. Yaqoob is the second top LeT terrorist against whom the NIA court in Jammu has issued an NBW since July 8, when it had issued the warrant against Hafiz Saeed, the Pakistan-based chief of the proscribed terror outfit, in connection with the Pahalgam terror attack case. According to the court order dated July 16, the warrant was sought by the NIA against Yaqoob in a case registered under UAPA, Arms Act and Explosive Substances Act at a police station in Srinagar.

title: 9 suffocate to death in sleep in Kolkata lodge fire, 5 Bangladeshis among them
content: nine people, at least five of them Bangladeshi nationals, choked to death in their sleep after a fire broke out at a lodge inside a five-storey building in central Kolkata . around 80 people were rescued from the building, which also houses several other guest houses, lodges, eateries, offices and retail outlets .

title: Congress Working Committee discusses Vande Mataram, firm on singing just 2 stanzas

title: Amazon fined Rs 1 lakh for misleading ads on 'Ram mandir prasad'
content: CCPA fined amazon Rs 1 lakh for allowing misleading ads on its platform . it found there was no authorisation from the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust . the phrase carries a specific and well-understood meaning for Hindu devotees .

title: 'Economic D-Day': Trump warns countries supporting Iran of 'tremendous consequences'

title: Paternity test of child can be allowed in marital dispute: SC
content: a man has sought divorce on the ground of alleged unchaste character of his wife . a bench of justices rejected the plea of a woman who had opposed a paternity test of the child . "if you are loyal, then why should you object to the test," the bench asked .

title: Mehul Choksi’s lawyer Vijay Aggarwal arrested in UK over sexual assault allegation
content: fugitive diamond businessman mehul Choksi, 57, is in jail charged with four sexual assault offences on two women . his personal assistant, manpreet Kaur, is also in jail for intentionally encouraging the commission of two offences . the pair, both Indian citizens, were arrested on Aug 11 at 29 Brick Street, Mayfair, a serviced luxury ambassadorial town house where they both were staying .
